title: Ordering Cannabis Online: Pickup or Delivery? | CastleLeaf
h1: Ordering Cannabis Online: Pickup or Delivery?
description: How ordering cannabis online works at CastleLeaf: browse the menu, pick up in store, use the Walk-in Express kiosk or choose Local Delivery to your door.
excerpt: Browse from the couch, then pick it up, tap through the kiosk or have it brought to your door. Here’s how each way of ordering from CastleLeaf works.
pull: Delivery doesn’t skip the ID check: it simply brings the counter to your doorstep.

sections.heading: More than one way to shop

blocks.html: We make it convenient to shop at our dispensary, with options like online ordering and in-store browsing. Here are the ways to buy, as our FAQ lists them:
This guide walks through the first two, with a closer look at Local Delivery. For the third, see how to talk to a budtender.

Our online menu is the shop window you can browse from anywhere: flower, pre-rolls, vaporizers, edibles, concentrates, topicals, tinctures and accessories, sorted into categories so you can compare at your own pace.
A few habits make online ordering easier:

items: Read each listing closely: the size, the type and any cannabinoid numbers shown.
Look at our specials before you check out. On bundle pages we note that the website cart may not reflect the bundled price, but it will be adjusted at time of payment.
If you’re new, keep your first order small and simple. Everyone responds differently.

sections.heading: Pickup: order from home, swing by when you’re ready

blocks.html: Pickup is the classic, and our line for it says it all: “Order from home and swing by when you’re ready.” Build your cart, place the order, then head to 100 Leo M Birmingham Pkwy in Brighton. There’s plenty of on-site parking in our lot, plus street parking in front of the dispensary.

Bring a valid government ID that shows you’re 21+. That goes for everyone, visitors from out of state included. We accept cash or debit cards, and if you forget cash, there’s an ATM on site. For opening times, see our store page.
Already in the neighborhood and know what you want? Our Walk-in Express is an in-store kiosk: “Place an order at our in-store kiosk and shop in peace.” It suits the decisive visit, on your own terms.
Changed your mind halfway through? Our knowledgeable and friendly staff are close by if you’d rather talk it through.

sections.heading: Local Delivery, straight to your door

blocks.html: And then there’s the easiest seat in the house: your own. CastleLeaf offers Local Delivery, “Cannabis quickly delivered straight to your door.” Choose Home Delivery when you order online, and your order comes to you.
Delivery doesn’t skip the ID check: it simply brings the counter to your doorstep. A little delivery etiquette goes a long way:

items: Someone 21 or older with a valid government ID needs to receive the order. Have your ID in hand when the doorbell rings.
Be home, and keep your phone close, just in case.
Give clear directions. In triple-deckers and apartment buildings, a unit number and a note about which door to use help a lot.
Put your order away as soon as it arrives, somewhere children, pets and anyone under 21 can’t get to it.

blocks.html: Our Local Delivery page has more on how it works. Questions before you order? Call us at (617) 202-5066.

items: Pickup if you like a quick stop, and maybe a chat at the counter.
Walk-in Express if you’re already here and know what you want.
Local Delivery if the couch is calling, or the weather is doing its Boston thing.
A budtender if you’re still deciding. That’s what they’re there for.

faq.q: Do I need an ID for delivery?
faq.a_html: Yes. Someone 21 or older with a valid government ID must receive the order, just as you would show ID at our counter.

faq.q: Can visitors from out of state order for pickup?
faq.a_html: Yes! Anyone 21+ with a valid government ID can make a purchase, including out of state. Remember that cannabis can’t travel outside Massachusetts with you.

faq.q: How do I pay in store?
faq.a_html: We accept cash or debit cards, and there’s an ATM on site. For delivery questions, call us at (617) 202-5066.
